checks.owner_name_pii_assessment: Approximately 3.4% of records (1,774 of 52,152) contain owner_name values that appear to be individual person names rather than formal corporate entity names (e.g., 'FRENCH DARRELL', 'ALLEN MONICA S', 'BAKER ROBERT E'). These are sole proprietors, co-owners, or individuals operating licensed establishments in their own name. Florida alcoholic beverage licenses are commercial operating licenses — the owner_name field is the legal licensee of record appearing in a public state regulatory database, not a consumer or private individual record. This is equivalent to a business registration or professional license: a commercial regulatory identifier voluntarily disclosed to obtain a government-issued operating permit. No contact information (email, phone, mailing address distinct from venue) is present. VERDICT: Acceptable commercial regulatory data. Not consumer PII.
checks.address_pii_assessment: All sampled addresses (20-row random sample + systematic review) are commercial venue addresses: restaurants, bars, package stores, gas stations, grocery stores, and distribution facilities operating at commercial properties. No residential address pattern was detected. The street_address field reflects the licensed premises — the physical location of the alcohol-serving establishment — which is inherently commercial and publicly regulated. VERDICT: Commercial property addresses, not residential PII.

notes: Source is Florida DBPR Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco, direct public CSV download at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/sto/file_download/extracts/bd400lic.csv — no login, no paywall, no scraping. Florida state government open data carries no explicit redistribution prohibition; state agency public records are not subject to copyright under Florida law (F.S. 119). No email, phone, SSN, financial account, or health data fields exist anywhere in the dataset. The dataset is B2B commercial licensing data for 52,152 active retail alcohol licensees across 67 Florida counties — a legitimate sales prospecting resource for beverage distributors, POS vendors, insurance brokers, and hospitality suppliers. All 14 columns are commercial regulatory fields: license identifiers, business names, commercial addresses, license classification, status, and dates.
